heading: What this site collects
lede: A short, plain account of what happens to anything you send this site, and how to get in touch about it.

sections.heading: What the contact form collects
body: The form on the contact page asks for your name, your email address, the service you are interested in, an optional budget range, and a short message. All of it is optional except your name, email address, service and message, which are needed so a reply can be useful.
Nothing else on this site asks you for anything. There is no account to create, no newsletter to opt into, and no comment or rating system.

sections.heading: What happens to it
body: Your message is read by Samad and used for one thing only: to answer your enquiry and, if it turns into a project, to discuss that project with you.

At the moment the form validates in your browser and does not transmit or store what you type, so nothing is recorded anywhere. When the form is connected to a mail service, that service will hold the message long enough to deliver it and no longer.
Your details are never sold, rented, or shared with advertisers or analytics providers.

sections.heading: This site's own storage
body: This site sets no tracking cookies, runs no analytics scripts, and embeds no third-party trackers, maps, or social media widgets. Nothing about your visit is profiled.
Your browser and your hosting provider may keep their own ordinary server logs. Those are used only to keep the site working and to investigate abuse.

sections.heading: How long anything is kept
body: Enquiry emails are kept while the conversation is active and for a reasonable period afterwards in case a project picks up again. Ask to have them deleted sooner and they will be.

contactBody: Email and either ask what is held, ask for it to be deleted, or ask anything else about this page. The same address works for new projects.
changesNote: If this notice changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it.
